payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the Sentence Reordering (SR) task is the most effective among the three pre-training tasks based on performance metrics and the nature of the task.

claims.text: Sentence Reordering (SR) is the most effective pre-training task compared to Next Sentence Generation (NSG) and Masked Document Generation (MDG).
SR requires a comprehensive understanding of a document, which aligns closely with the goals of abstractive document summarization.
Using SR for pre-training leads to significant improvements in summarization performance on benchmark datasets.
